title: Leeds commuting (mid-level, one wrong figure)
question:
The chart below shows how commuters in Leeds travelled to work in 1995 and 2015.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
data:
% of commuters, 1995 → 2015
Car: 42 → 31
Bus: 23 → 28
Bicycle: 11 → 19
Walk: 24 → 22
essay:
The bar chart shows the way people travel to work in Leeds in 1995 and 2015.

In 1995, car was the most popular way with 42% of commuters. Walking was second with 24% and bus was 23%. Only 11% of people used bicycle.

In 2015 the number of car users decreased to 31% but it was still the most popular. Bus increase to 28% and bicycle increased a lot to 25%. Walking was almost same, it fall a little to 22%.

The reason of this change maybe because government build more cycle lanes and petrol is expensive now. Many people also care about environment so they choose bicycle and bus.

Overall, car is the most common transport in both years, but less people used it in 2015 and more people use bus and bicycle.
